blind_target.authors: Marshall, CA; Curran, MA; Koerner, SS; Kroll, T; Hickman, A; García, F
blind_target.title: Un Abrazo Para La Familia: An evidenced-based rehabilitation approach in providing cancer education to low-SES Hispanic co-survivors
blind_target.evidence_quote: The objective of the Portland replication was to train 20 promotoras to implement Abrazo in their communities with at least 120 Latino cancer survivors and co-survivors.
blind_target.outcome_quote: Portland promotoras demonstrated that when the Abrazo intervention is provided via a culturally congruent, accessible format, the significant gains in cancer knowledge and self-efficacy reported by underserved co-survivors can be replicated.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: The authors explicitly state that the Portland implementation replicated the prior Tucson gains in knowledge and self-efficacy.

luna_triage.reason: The source explicitly replicates initial Tucson Abrazo gains, but its supplied reference list identifies a 2013 report of the program while the shipped row is a 2011 report with a different title. The supplied text does not establish whether these are alternate reports of the same initial evaluation/finding or distinct original empirical work. Needed: source-level linkage between the 2011 and 2013 reports (for example, same Tucson sample/evaluation and reported knowledge/self-efficacy gains).
luna_triage.omission_quote: Our goal in this study was to determine if we could replicate initial findings when providing the intervention, Un Abrazo Para La Familia (“Abrazo”).
